description:
FOUND + FIXED s473t6c (#1501 ROUND 10).

THE BUG.  A PPI "full" quote token (qq{} qq[] qx{} qr{} m{} s{}{} <$fh>) does
not keep its body as text: it keeps a SECTION RECORD -- {position, size}
offsets into its own content -- and every body reader slices the content with
it (PPI's own ->string, Pl::PExpr::_command_body).  `set_content` replaces the
TEXT and leaves that record alone.  Parser2's interpolation rewriter LENGTHENS
a name when a file lexical is identity-promoted ($v -> $v__file__0), so the
size was too small and the body was cut at exactly the ORIGINAL length.

MINIMAL REPRODUCER (perl | PCL before the fix):
    my $out;
    { my $v = 1; $out = qq{A "q{x $v y}"}; }      # an inner shadow, so there
    my $v = 3;                                    #   is a region to rename
    $out = qq{A "q{x $v y}"};                     # -> A "q{x     (tail gone)
    print "$out\n";
    sub g { return $v }                           # forces the promotion
Also measured on the same fixture, before the fix:
    s{x $v y}{got $v ok}   ->  le__0 y}{3 y    (BOTH sections mangled)
    qx{echo "a{$v}b"}      ->  (empty)

THE FIX.  `Pl::Parser2::_resync_quote_sections`, called from the ONE site that
set_contents such a token (`_fix_interp_token`, which all seven rename callers
go through): re-lex the new text with PPI itself and take the fresh record.
The text is lexed as an ASSIGNMENT'S RIGHT-HAND SIDE, because that is the one
context in which every affected spelling lexes as itself -- a bare `<$fh>` is
three operators on its own (probed: qq{} qq[] qx{} qr// m{} s{}{} <$fh>
<STDIN> "â¦" `â¦` s/// m// tr///).  A record that cannot be re-lexed DIES naming
the token: rule 12, since the value it feeds is the string's own text.

NOT A PPI BUG (CLAUDE.md rule 13 scope): PPI tokenizes correctly;
`set_content` is a documented low-level setter and keeping the metadata
consistent is the caller's job.

BARS: corpus-diff IDENTICAL over 111.  Emission A/B over lib/ + perl-tests/ +
t/op/ + the SHAPES corpus = 360 files, 359 SAME, 1 DIFF (t/op/exec.t, the
positive control), RCDIFF 0 -- the new die never fires.  The full perl-tests
sweep GATE clean, TOTAL 18686 (+0).  Guard
`Pl/t/interp-rename-sections-01.t` (8 rows, 302 ms), inverse-verified on a
`4c6565e5` extraction where 4 of the 8 fail.
subject: FIXED s473t6c: a rename inside a PPI full-quote token left its SECTION RECORD stale, so the body was SILENTLY TRUNCATED (qq{} qq[] s{}{} qx{})
